visual_brief.subject: GPT-6 Cyber raises the bar—and the containment burden
verified_context: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber to selected approved Daybreak Red customers.
OpenAI reports stronger exploit-development results and better adherence to authorized task scope.
The results are first-party evaluations and external authorization, isolation and audit controls remain necessary.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Stronger offensive capability increases the importance of independent containment boundaries.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A compact dark-metal security instrument sits inside layered stone containment with one narrow terracotta authorized channel.

candidate_notes.A: Selected: four pale-stone containment layers isolate one compact dark instrument while a single terracotta channel remains visible through every boundary. The silhouette remains explicit at thumbnail and square crops.
candidate_notes.B: The oblique maze conveys defensive depth, but overlapping walls make the authorized channel harder to trace and the composition becomes busy in compact crops.
candidate_notes.C: Concentric rings provide a clean containment metaphor, but their repeated circular form is less closely aligned with the rectilinear architectural language of the declared references.

crop_review.article_desktop: The 21:9 center crop retains all four containment layers, the instrument and the authorized channel.
crop_review.article_mobile: The full layered enclosure and channel remain visible in 16:9.
crop_review.square: The square center crop tightens around the instrument while preserving each boundary crossing.
crop_review.thumbnail: At 320px wide, the dark instrument and terracotta channel remain a clear focal pair.

golden_reference_comparison: Compared all candidates above the two declared references for pale-stone architecture, restrained terracotta/charcoal contrast, tactile materiality and compact legibility. A best matches the reference language while communicating containment and authorized access without decorative complexity.

generation_metadata.visual_review: Codex model self-review of three full-size candidates, the two declared golden references, a reference-first comparison sheet, and desktop/mobile/square/thumbnail crops. The canonical Playwright renderer could not launch because Chromium was unavailable, so ImageMagick produced the equivalent inspected sheet; repository validation remains authoritative.

A.prompt: Wide architectural cutaway of a compact dark security instrument inside four pale-stone containment layers, crossed only by one narrow terracotta authorized channel; tactile editorial materials, no text or interface elements.

B.prompt: Wide oblique stone defensive maze around a compact dark security instrument with one terracotta authorized path; restrained tactile editorial materiality and no prohibited elements.

C.prompt: Wide concentric stone containment rings around a compact dark security instrument with one terracotta authorized channel; restrained editorial materiality and no prohibited elements.
